notes.title: Mini GUNN!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365401/84dafbb1d82193dfdc439d454fe929e8ae4c9ec2.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365401/0594b5b42245645029850a0235ca1fdd0013004d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365401/c62fc70a392587de2334c071925c9ed03554a6d8.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365401/6b2ccbb4c1c9813ce608f2eeb6669d5634b006cb.gif[/img]

Community members sirmilkman and Waporwave have created a Samurai GUNN 2 demake called [b]Mini GUNN[/b]!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3035660/Mini_GUNN/]Play it right now on steam, for [b]free![/b][/url]



[h3]Samurai GUNN 2 New Engine Progress[/h3]

A lot has happened since the last Samurai GUNN 2 Update. We've moved on from using Game Maker, built our own game engine, and have been hard at work re-writing the entire game. Because of this we've been able to address some major issues and create a strong technical foundation so that we can support the game long term.

Our task tracker says we're 58.33% done! ːsteamthumbsupː

Here's a bit of what we've got cooking:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365401/89d562f002b0b1d854d13f03a303fb694f3f2226.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365401/4a4d043b7fe8eed3e88badfe4feb661053f6e0d0.gif[/img]

- Character Buffs!
We're adding some extra sauce to every character! For example, Slug can now run on ceilings, and Pops has a deadly new throw.

- Rollback Netcode
We have re-built the entire game from the ground up with a focus on rollback netcode. It works, and it rules.

- Ranked and Casual Matchmaking
Find your most exciting and balanced match-ups thanks to our new matchmaking features which implement the Glicko-2 rating system. Not in it to win it? Hop into the casual queue and enjoy a variety of less serious game modes instead.

- Cross Platform Networking
We've been very serious about creating a code-base that's stable long term so we can support the game on Switch, PS5, Xbox, and whatever new devices may arrive in the future. Not only that, but you'll be able to play against anyone online, regardless of what platform they're using.



Thanks for reading! We're looking forward to the re-launch of Samurai GUNN 2

If you'd like to keep up with our work, you can peep our day-to-day git commits in the [url=https://discord.com/channels/763177752521605120/1004555790994128926]#devlog channel[/url] of the [url=https://discord.gg/8pVDPfPmwX]Samurai Gunn 2 discord[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365401/289bb1d1e5c4007b173a17ad197ecf4d52c11ec7.gif[/img]
LISE Project, Au, and Pilot blast in for some fun! There's sticky bombs, rocks, skulls, torches, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1397790/view/3379415101030013618]and more[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365401/6a2616176669ff0ab75b4cdcb92edf43f6bd8383.gif[/img]The gang's all here, with 3 new Minit characters! And the Minit kit got a whole rework—watering can boost rocket, bullet-deflecting sword throws, less active frames on slash, dash through Minit's sword throw... it's all been buffed, it's all been nerfed, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1397790/view/3379415101029247171]flee in terror and have the time of your life[/url]! ☠️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365401/4a547505764f9208969ecaeef47b0a62622b705b.gif[/img]

notes.title: K.D. rolls into battle! 😏
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=o-Xtdlwe8ew;full][previewyoutube=jixdX1G3rt0;full][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New Character![/h2]
The results are in, and Future Kid K.D. won! Our first (of many!) community voted character updates for Samurai Gunn 2. Check out his new tricks:

[h3]Pizza Roll[/h3]
Hold down + left / right when landing to roll. Throw off your opponent's offense, or get away from trouble in a jiffy. You can even roll under bullets!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365401/e91168e52d0c1b354f92f06f202d1f8677b8826c.gif[/img]

[h3]Catch 'Em All[/h3]
Dash into an opponent to steal their ammo! K.D. also keeps any special bullet effects he's stolen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365401/9236c17bb291bc404ae1a56978e9182853f5831e.gif[/img]
That goes for Friends characters too! No one can stop K.D. from completing his collection.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365401/dbbe90f0ddfe7e30a80b7945d44817358669673d.gif[/img]

[h3]Hot Pocket[/h3]
Dash and slash a bullet to instantly pocket it! It may be covered in lint but it's still good I promise!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365401/e3f673aafaf9e47db5db57a5fd160910a9b47a28.gif[/img]

[h2]New Stages![/h2]

[h3]Trap Temple[/h3]
A fan favorite has returned. As the match draws closer to its finale, the floors pull farther apart! There's something curious in the distance... is that a robot?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365401/f39ddd088d319e9cf96685c190bed8753aaac48d.gif[/img]

[h3]Chopping Block[/h3]
Become Samurai Smoothie in our deadliest stage yet.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365401/15eff7f561c8d67c6c5d41124a1d541a60064195.gif[/img]

[h2]Wall-Dashing[/h2]
An underused mechanic just got some extra love. Wall Dashing!
Press Jump during a dash to reflect off of the nearest wall.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365401/c3737983039490ea39c17ea0c71e1d8aeb278f51.gif[/img]

[h2]Character Buffs[/h2]
Ghost, Hayao, and Pops have been hitting the gym for some new [i]buffs[/i]:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365401/fb4697a2d66bca04f5f24e0beb756ded2d721fb3.gif[/img]
[list]
[*]Ghost’s invisibility time increased
[*]Ghost's float lasts longer
[*]Ghost can float out of falling spawns
[*]Ghost’s float recharges from wall-sliding and sword kills
[*]Ghost’s invisibility time resets if she gets a kill while invisible
[*]Ghost’s position is no longer revealed during the widescreen kill effect if she is invisible
[*]Hayao can run up walls infinitely without getting tired
[*]Hayao can sword fling out of a wall run
[*]Pop’s throw stuns opponents for longer
[/list]
For the entire list of gameplay tweaks and bug fixes, [b]scroll to the bottom for the full Update Log[/b].

[h2]Community Creations[/h2]

Check out what the incredible folks on our Discord have been making! ([url=https://discord.gg/jKtVxbe]And while you're here, join us![/url])

[*]Can dash in and out of water without getting wet
[*]Increased dash time when wall-dashing
[*]Dashing resets sword fling (after dashing, swinging your sword adds momentum in the direction of the attack for one swing until hitting the ground, or dashing again)

[i][b]CHARACTER BUFFS[/b][/i]

notes.title: Helmsley Shatters His Chains!!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365401/98d831431012eecdfccbe8453858af8b3d325d28.gif[/img]
[previewyoutube=ZYCKyIQpwcA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]New Character![/h2]
The mysterious Gunn Powder Knight is here! Helmsley is our first character update for Samurai Gunn 2. He can grind for unlimited ammo and stomp on bullets—even his own! Check out his movelist:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365401/7f503e2c483210115ab3ee574f3a9164c5b979f6.png[/img]

We know what you’re thinking... No, there is no ammo limit! Grind as much as you want, but don't get greedy! Helmsley gets weighed down by each bullet, making hoarders easy prey.

So who is this deadly machine? One of these new Versus stages may lift a ragged curtain on Helmsley's past:

[h2]New Stages![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365401/1da8acd4cf6f05cb602427d344cb02143969c3cd.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365401/40fdffeda4b63b8b8f32338b6c8c88dd6e70d97c.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365401/6fadcb2329e8c713a5375feed061456382dc8064.gif[/img]

[h2]New Lives Mode![/h2]

Introducing Lives Mode, the new default for online matchmaking! Can you cut down your opponents’ bamboo before they do? You have ten lives, so make ‘em count! Even those Spelunky traps are deadlier now...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365401/874a213d52e0136fe6f2c50458437e251b6c1150.gif[/img]

[h2]New GFX Tech![/h2]

To make these levels possible, we built some intense new graphics tech! First up is dynamic water caustic reflection. Hi Fi meets Lo Fi!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365401/1069f08688f5ad2f1466a2bc3a761586c5396b65.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365401/c00dcaf9b6e196f64646159f65581f625114e2e5.gif[/img]

And how about some fully dynamic cloth? Push it! Slash it! If it's hanging by a thread, our wind system will even rip it apart!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365401/720e0f763016f78742fff568d95a80775200cbbe.gif[/img]

[h2]8 New Music Tracks by Doseone![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365401/d94e144374ba5fff2a12890c5d25f240fe4eff1e.gif[/img]

[h2]EA4 Update Log[/h2]

[i][b]NEW CHARACTER![/b][/i]
[list]
[*]HELMSLEY - GUNN POWDER KNIGHT
[/list]

[i][b]NEW VERSUS STAGES![/b][/i]
[list]

[*]Spines

[list]

[/list]

[list]
[*]Lives Mode - 10 lives per character, survivor wins
[*]New animated bamboo HUD for Lives mode
[*]Online Versus matchmaking is now in Lives mode
[/list]

[b]Features and Gameplay Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed tumble fall and wall bounce behavior

[*]Adjusted Slug's kunai tilt inputs to be more forgiving

[b]Bug Fixes and Performance Improvements[/b]

That's it! Have fun grinding for bullets, and tell your friends to jump in on the action!

[h1]EA3 UPDATE LOG[/h1]

[b][i]NEW VS STAGES![/i][/b]
[list]
[*] Nostril
[*] Playground
[/list]
[b]UI Flow Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Player Icons are now displayed in character select
[*] User avatars are now displayed in character select
[*] Controls are now displayed in character select
[*] Only Online Host can use default menu inputs (Arrows, Esc, Enter, Backspace)
[*] Only player who paused can control the pause menu
[*] Can pause and return to overworld during adventure levels
[/list]
[b]New Online Party Features[/b]
[list]
[*] You can kick other players out of your online party
[*] You can copy a steam lobby invite link to your clipboard. (Post it online! Other players who own the game and click the link will instantly join your online lobby!)
[/list]
[b]Control Configuration[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where controller rebindings were not assigning correctly on startup
[*] Pressing delete when configuring an input clears binding
[/list]
[b]Polish + Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] In Roulette mode—which includes online matchmaking—the stage select algorithm will no longer select the same stage twice in a row
[*] When blood splashes in water, it now mixes with the water
[*] Updated the logic for sword and gunn animations
[*] Tumble dust drawn behind characters for clarity
[*] Added an explosion sound when 2 super bullets collide
[*] Player input no longer buffers during pause
[/list]
[b]Additional Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the exploit that allowed players to gain infinite speed while shooting with no ammo and slashing
[*] Statues rising out of ground in Adventure mode no longer ignore volume settings
[*] Palette-swapped enemies now remain the correct color after being killed 
[*] Dev /console commands now clear after being entered
[*] Discord link should now work for all players
[*] Fixed Ana rope crash
[*] Credits page no longer crashes when using directional inputs
[*] Visual FX no longer spawn on the overworld map while paused
[*] Fixed missing map objects
[*] Can’t spawn weapons during rematch screen (for now, to fix desyncs)
[*] Winning with a red kill streak and turning your opponent to petals no longer desyncs
[*] Fixed a desync that sometimes happened when a player won a match
[*] Slug deflected bullets and tilting them now works again
[/list]
